source: Extracted from official Eben Institute pitch deck and logo

usage.primary: Main CTA buttons, active tab, focused inputs, links, highlighted chips
usage.primaryDark: Headers, pressed states, nav emphasis, dark branded surfaces
usage.primaryDeep: Gradients, deep accents, footer or splash support color
usage.accentGold: Badges, achievement highlights, icons, celebratory accents
usage.accentSun: Secondary accent, illustrations, warning-friendly warm emphasis
usage.accentBlue: Informational accents, secondary chips, subtle supportive contrast
usage.surface: Light cards, sheets, auth backgrounds, empty states

notes: Prefer green as the primary action color throughout the app.
Use gold and sun as supportive accents, not dominant UI colors.
Blue should remain secondary and be used sparingly for informational emphasis.
Keep strong contrast for readability on Android devices.
